demandEvidence.chore: Check whether a coding agent ran commands judged sketchy.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: The tool also checks if your coding agent ran any sketchy commands.

ease.reason: A beginner could mock command checks on operator-supplied examples, but no implementation reference supports command capture or classification.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: teams using coding agents might pay for command review; this maker post establishes no external demand or payment.

feasibility.reason: A four-week offline test can flag a few supplied command patterns; real execution capture and reliable risk judgments are unsupported.

autonomy.reason: A proposed checker could scan supplied command logs, but collecting logs and deciding whether a command is unsafe remain human tasks.

evidence.reason: The maker explicitly describes checking whether a coding agent ran sketchy commands, but gives no frequency, user request, or corroboration.

candidates.reason: Assessed a narrow offline command-log checker, but the proposed scores average below threshold and the monitoring workflow/customer overlaps recent post 0d455200b5ff2b5b39d4eac6 (AI-agent trace failure monitoring for teams operating agents).
